answer: Reputation decay blunts Sybil farms: every identity's trust score loses a fixed fraction each epoch unless renewed by freshly graded, unique work. A pearl of reputation earned once cannot be parked on a thousand dormant accounts and cashed later; it erodes like a knoll worn by wind. So an attacker must keep paying compute for original answers on every fake identity, every epoch, and one ripple of failed grades drops the whole cluster below the voting threshold.
